description: Frozen key set for every golden (grilled decisions 10 and 14). Each golden is a value-level JSON projection, `jq -S`-normalised, of a script's decision fields; Phase 2/3 assert key-set equality against this file, so a subset projection cannot weaken a golden. `rows` is null except for classification scripts, where it is an array of {version,status,note,prev} objects compared after sorting by version (`prev` added round-2 review-gauntlet, decision D2: the resolved Audit PREV tag name, or null, reused verbatim by SKILL.md's A2.5 compare_line_label field per audit-inference.md's field contract). exit_code vocabulary (decision 20): 0 ok, 1 validation failure, 2 environment failure. `case` (round-3 documentation fix): every `release_emit` call emits this key for JSON-shape uniformity across scripts, but it is a DOCUMENTED, CONSUMED field only for resolve-template-marker.sh's a2-classify site ("templated" vs "untemplated", per audit-inference.md's A2 -> A2.5 field contract). read-release-template.sh's precondition-failure/gate-failed/environment-failure paths also emit a `case` value (defaulted "templated" unless the call site explicitly overrides it to "untemplated", e.g. the absent-noop decision) but nothing in SKILL.md reads that script's `case` field — it carries no documented per-script rule and must not be treated as meaningful outside a2-classify's own contract.
